ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota and follow the money trail to determine the extent of the fraud and who is involved.
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota?
Who is involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the child care system. By following the money trail, we can determine the extent of the fraud and who is involved.
